resources.string: Accessibility Auto-Reader inspects on-screen visible text, reads it aloud using the device native Text-to-Speech engine, and automatically scrolls down pages continuously. AAR runs 100% offline with zero internet access.
Continuous screen reading and automated downward scrolling
Auto Reader is disabled in settings. Click to enable.
Auto Reader is ready. Click to start reading.
Auto Reader is actively reading. Click to pause.
AAR requires the Android AccessibilityService API to provide screen reading and continuous automatic scrolling. Please review how this permission is used:
Reads visible text on your active screen and transfers it to the device native Text-to-Speech (TTS) engine for sentence-by-sentence spoken playback.
Dispatches scroll actions or simulated upward swipe gestures when the visible text has been spoken, allowing continuous reading without touching the screen.

AAR does NOT declare or request internet permission (android.permission.INTERNET is completely absent). All processing occurs strictly on your device. Text is kept in memory only during speech synthesis and is never saved to disk or transmitted anywhere.
Password fields (isPassword == true) and secure screens are strictly filtered out and will never be accessed or read.
